title: 第738章 佛与魔第737章 第三杀
content_zh:
村中。
所有人都愣在了原地，半晌说不出话。
孙悟空干净利落地除掉二人，轻松一笑：
“终于安静了！”
“俺老孙忍你们很久了……”
孙悟空话音落下。
“咕咚！”
“咕咚……”
一众村民悄悄吞咽唾沫，一脸惊骇地朝后退去。
这时候，再也没有人出言辱骂孙悟空了。
任谁都看得出来，此时的孙悟空已经失控了。
连一旁的唐玄奘都只是沉默，没有开口。
见一众村民都默契地退后。
孙悟空环视众人，嘿嘿一笑：
“怎么了？”
“你们怎么不骂俺老孙了？”
“俺老孙可是当着你们的面，将你们村长给杀了。”
“你们怎么不替他打抱不平呢？”
听到孙悟空的话。
一众村民全都沉默，不敢与孙悟空对视。

见到一众村民的反应。
孙悟空摇了摇头，轻叹道：
“真是无趣！”
说着。
孙悟空身形一闪，来到之前那名与自己争执的中年农夫面前。
见孙悟空找上自己。
那中年农夫连忙低头，不敢看孙悟空。
见到这中年农夫的反应。
孙悟空咧嘴一笑：
“嘿嘿！”
“你怎么不继续说了？”
“俺老孙之前看你挺能说的。”
听到孙悟空的询问。
那中年农夫看向孙悟空，声音颤抖：
“大……大王饶命。”
“小的知错了！”
“小的再也不敢了！”
听到中年农夫的话。
孙悟空眉头一扬：
“你叫错了。”

“俺老孙是大圣，不是大王。”
“下辈子你再重新叫吧。”
说完，孙悟空举起金箍棒便要砸下。
那中年农夫吓地脸色苍白，跪倒在地，不断磕头：
content_en:
In the village.
Everyone was stunned on the spot, speechless for a long time.
Sun Wukong got rid of the two of them cleanly and smiled easily:
"It's finally quiet!"
"I, Sun, have tolerated you for a long time..."
Sun Wukong finished speaking.
"Gudong!"
"Gudong..."
The villagers swallowed quietly and backed away with a look of horror on their faces.
At this time, no one insulted Sun Wukong anymore.
Everyone could see that Sun Wukong was out of control at this time.
Even Tang Xuanzang on the side was silent and did not speak.
Seeing all the villagers retreating tacitly.
Sun Wukong looked around at everyone and smiled:
"What's wrong?"
"Why don't you scold me, grandson?"
"I, Old Sun, killed your village chief in front of you."
"Why don't you fight for him?"
Hear what Sun Wukong said.
All the villagers were silent, not daring to look at Sun Wukong.
See the reactions of the villagers.
Sun Wukong shook his head and sighed:
"It's so boring!"
Said.
Sun Wukong flashed and came to the middle-aged farmer who had argued with him before.
Seeing Sun Wukong coming to find him.
The middle-aged farmer quickly lowered his head, not daring to look at Sun Wukong.
See this middle-aged farmer’s reaction.
Sun Wukong grinned:
"Hey!"
"Why don't you continue?"
"I, Old Sun, have seen that you are quite eloquent before."
Hear Sun Wukong's question.
The middle-aged farmer looked at Sun Wukong and his voice trembled:
"Your Majesty, please spare my life."
"I know I was wrong, little one!"
"I don't dare to do that anymore, little one!"
Hear the words of the middle-aged farmer.
Sun Wukong raised his eyebrows:
"You called it wrong."
"My grandson is a great sage, not a great king."
"You can call me again in your next life."
After saying that, Sun Wukong raised the golden cudgel and was about to smash it down.
The middle-aged farmer turned pale with fright, fell to his knees, and kept kowtowing:
